title: Recording leaked to Globo and the case ridiculed

tellings.quote: it, he leaked the recording at the time to a TV network called Globu in Brazil. And this network every time would ridicule the case,

plain: Around 1996 and 1997, a recording connected to a Brazilian case was leaked to Globo, Brazil's big TV network, and the network's show kept making fun of the case every time it came up. This comes from a surgeon named Carlos de Souza, who says he was involved in the case and whose hospital, he says, operated on an alien. He names a person called Claudia Kovu in connection with it. He tells it to explain how the case got laughed off in public instead of being looked into.
